sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet showing drawing index for 7 sheets. Project title: B8175 MODIFY WASTE WATER TREATMENT PLANT, Webster Field Annex, St. Inigoes, MD. Construction Contract No. N40080-19-D-0003. Vicinity map and location map shown. BFA logo and NAVFAC seal visible. EOR stamp: Marcos Freeman, MD Lic. 841286, dated 2-14-22.

sheets.title: BORING LOGS
sheets.reading_notes: Boring logs from Bob Taylor Engineering, Inc. Two boring logs (B-1 and B-2) shown. Boring location plan at 1/8"=1'-0" shows three sludge drying beds in a row (approximate footprint ~78' × 38'). Soils include brown silty sand and loose gray sands. Key notes indicate existing building to remain, existing 8" CMU stem wall foundation, existing concrete slab-on-grade, and existing sand.

sheets.title: GENERAL NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: General structural notes, design codes and governing standards, design loads. Key data: ROOF LIVE LOAD = 20 PSF; SNOW LOAD (Pg) = 20 PSF, Exposure Ce = 1.0; WIND: Ultimate design wind speed 105 MPH (ASCE 7, 2nd Gust), Nominal 82 MPH, Risk Category I, Wind Exposure C; SEISMIC: Risk Category I, Ie = 1.0, Seismic Design Category A. Design codes: UFC 1-200-01, UFC 3-301-01 (Architecture), UFC 3-110-05 (Roofing), UFC 3-201-01 (Civil), UFC 3-301-01 (Structural), IBC 2018, ASCE 7, AWC NDS-2015. Foundation: max allowable soil bearing 2,000 PSF (Bob Taylor Engineering geotechnical report). Abbreviations table included. Prefabricated metal-plate-connected wood trusses per TPI design standards; southern pine (SPIB rules), pressure treated, MC ≤15%.

sheets.title: TYPICAL DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Typical structural connection details. Includes: typical concrete pier and footing detail (4"×4" sq. pier, 4'-6"×4'-6"×1'-0" footing, #6 vert. bars); typical plywood diaphragm detail; typical multi-ply LVL beam connection detail; typical beam-to-post connection details (1/2" galv. steel plates, 3/4" thru bolts); typical brace-to-king truss connection detail (8×8 P.T. brace). All structure open — no side walls or panels. Confirms A-frame design.

sheets.title: FOUNDATION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Partial foundation plan at 1/4"=1'-0". Overall footprint: 78'-7.5" (width across 4 column lines) × 38'-0" (depth). Column bay spacings: 2'-7.5" + 23'-11.5" + 29'-10.5" + 24'-9.5" + 2'-7.5" = 83'-6.5" (with overhang adjustments). New 2"–4"× concrete piers on 4'-6"×4'-6"×1'-0" concrete footings at each post location. 12×12 pressure-treated posts. Existing CMU stem walls, slab-on-grade, and concrete light pole pier noted to remain. No roof area tabulation shown.

sheets.title: ROOF FRAMING PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Roof framing plan at 1/4"=1'-0". Overall roof framing span: 78'-7.5" × 38'-0". LVL beams: (5)-1 3/4"×18" LVL along each column line (top and bottom chord). Rafters: 2× (pressure treated) wood trusses, equally spaced not to exceed 24" o.c. King trusses at each interior column line (3-ply king truss). 8×8 braces at each post. 5 rows of trusses across width — 4 bays spanning three drying beds. Roof ridge at centerline. Confirms open structure, no walls.

sheets.title: SECTIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Four cross-sections at 1"=1'-0" (B1, B3 at ends; A1, A3 at interior). Key dimension: 16'-5" from top of concrete slab to underside of beam/truss assembly (eave height ~14'-4" above slab based on 4:12 pitch and 12 unit run). Roof pitch confirmed 4:12 (3-unit rise over 12 units with 12 labeled). Continuous aluminum gutter on both sides. 3/4" roof sheathing with asphalt shingles. 1/2" galv. steel connection plates at truss-to-beam. Simpson Strong-Tie H55 hurricane clips on all trusses. 8×8 P.T. braces at each post for lateral stability. Open structure — no enclosure.
